title: PERCEPT: A Corpus for POS Tagging and Analysis of Persian-English Code-Mixing
abstract: arXiv:2608.10109v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Social media has become a major venue for multilingual communication, where users frequently mix multiple languages within a single utterance. Although code-mixed corpora have been developed for several language pairs, Persian-English code-mixing remains relatively underexplored. Existing Persian resources lack Universal Dependencies (UD) part-of-speech (POS) annotations for code-mixed words, limiting both linguistic analyses and the development of syntax-aware NLP models. To address this gap, we introduce PERCEPT, the first publicly available large-scale Persian-English code-mixed corpus annotated with Universal Dependencies POS tags for code-mixed words. The dataset comprises 6,800 posts collected from Twitter (X), Instagram, and Digikala, each containing at least one identified Persian-English code-mixed word. We further present an LLM-assisted annotation framework that automatically assigns POS tags and document-level topics. Hum

translated_title: PERCEPT：一个用于波斯语-英语混合语码词性标注与分析的语料库
translated_abstract: 社交媒体已成为多语言交流的重要场所，用户经常在单句话语中混合使用多种语言。尽管目前已有针对若干语言对开发的混合语码语料库，但波斯语-英语混合语码仍然相对缺乏研究。现有的波斯语资源缺乏针对混合语码词汇的通用依存分析（UD）词性（POS）标注，这既限制了语言学分析，也限制了句法感知自然语言处理模型的开发。为填补这一空白，我们推出了PERCEPT——首个公开可用的大规模波斯语-英语混合语码语料库，为其中的混合语码词汇标注了通用依存分析词性标签。该数据集包含从Twitter（X）、Instagram和Digikala收集的6,800条帖子，每条帖子至少包含一个已识别的波斯语-英语混合语码词汇。我们还进一步提出了一个LLM辅助的标注框架，可自动分配词性标签和文档级主题。
tldr: 本文推出了PERCEPT——首个公开可用的大规模波斯语-英语混合语码语料库，包含6,800条社交媒体帖子并为混合语码词汇提供通用依存词性标注，同时提出了LLM辅助的自动标注框架。
en_tdlr: We introduce PERCEPT, the first publicly available large-scale Persian-English code-mixed corpus with Universal Dependencies POS annotations for 6,800 social media posts, along with an LLM-assisted automatic annotation framework.
